steps.message:
**Follow the provided skill first** — Use the skill named `web-design-expert` as your primary workflow. Each skill has its own generation approach that produces higher-quality results. Leverage the skill's design system, templates, and rendering pipeline to maximize output quality.

# MedBook — Corporate Landing Page

## Overview

MedBook is an online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists. The single-page site should feel **modern, professional, and approachable** — think ZocDoc meets a friendly health brand. The target audience is everyday patients looking to quickly find and book a doctor, so clarity and ease-of-use are paramount. Every design choice should reduce friction and build trust.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Use a clean, calming primary blue (think `#0066FF` or similar healthcare blue) paired with white backgrounds and light gray sections for contrast. Accent with a warm teal or green for CTAs and success states.
- **Typography:** A modern sans-serif like Inter or similar — large, confident headings with generous whitespace. Body text should be highly readable at 16px+.
- **Mood:** Bright, airy, optimistic. Use soft shadows, rounded corners on cards, and friendly iconography (line icons or simple filled icons for specialties). Avoid anything clinical or sterile — lean into the "playful" part of the tone with subtle micro-interactions and warm illustration-style visuals.

## Key Priorities

1. **The search bar is the hero experience.** It should be visually dominant, immediately communicating "type here to find a doctor." The autocomplete dropdown interaction must feel snappy and intuitive — this is the core conversion moment.
2. **Specialty cards** need to be scannable and inviting — use recognizable icons and clear labels so users can browse at a glance.
3. **Platform stats** should convey scale and trust without feeling like a wall of numbers. Make them visually punchy.
4. **Mobile responsiveness is critical** — the hamburger menu toggle and overall layout must work flawlessly on small screens since many patients search on their phones.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full structural breakdown of sections, interactions, and data display requirements.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# MedBook — Find and Book Top Doctors Instantly

## Brand
MedBook is an online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists for easy same-day booking. The platform empowers patients to search by specialty, location, and insurance, read verified reviews, and book appointments online in minutes — all completely free for patients. The tone is modern, professional, and playful, making healthcare access feel simple and approachable.

Brand colors: #1B1464 (primary navy), #FFD930 (accent yellow), #FFFFFF (background white)

## Hero Content
Title: Find and book the care you need
Subtitle: Search thousands of doctors, dentists, and specialists. Read verified patient reviews. Book appointments instantly — even same-day. It's that easy, and always free.
CTA: "Find a Doctor" | "Search"

Search bar placeholder: Search by condition, specialty, or doctor name
Location field placeholder: City, state, or zip code
Insurance field placeholder: Choose your insurance plan

## Search Bar
The primary search interface includes three fields:
- **Specialty / Condition / Doctor** — autocomplete text input with dropdown suggestions (e.g., "Dentist," "Back pain," "Dr. Sarah Chen")
- **Location** — city, state, or zip code with geolocation auto-detect option
- **Insurance** — dropdown selector with major insurance carriers (Aetna, Blue Cross, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, etc.)

CTA Button: "Search"

## Popular Specialties
A grid of clickable specialty cards that navigate to filtered search results:

- **Primary Care** — Annual checkups, sick visits, and preventive care
- **Dentist** — Cleanings, fillings, and oral health exams
- **Dermatologist** — Skin conditions, acne, and cosmetic consultations
- **Psychiatrist** — Mental health evaluations and medication management
- **Eye Doctor** — Vision exams, glasses prescriptions, and eye health
- **Orthopedic Surgeon** — Joint pain, fractures, and sports injuries

Each card includes a specialty icon and label. Clicking a card triggers a filtered search for that specialty.

## How It Works
A three-step visual guide explaining the MedBook booking flow:

1. **Search for a provider** — Enter your specialty, condition, or doctor name along with your location and insurance. Browse detailed provider profiles with photos, credentials, and office hours.
2. **Choose a time that works for you** — View real-time availability and pick an appointment slot that fits your schedule — including same-day and next-day options.
3. **Book your appointment instantly** — Confirm your visit in just a few clicks. Receive instant confirmation and reminders so you never miss an appointment.

## Platform Statistics
Key metrics displayed as a horizontal stats bar or badge row:

- **4.8M+** verified patient reviews
- **12,000+** healthcare providers nationwide
- **Same-day** appointments available daily
- **100% free** for patients — always

## Testimonials
- "I found a great dermatologist near my office and booked a same-day appointment during my lunch break. MedBook made it incredibly easy." — **Priya M.**, New York, NY
- "As someone new to the city, MedBook helped me find a primary care doctor who accepts my insurance in under five minutes. Highly recommend!" — **James T.**, Chicago, IL
- "I was dreading finding a new dentist, but the verified reviews on MedBook gave me confidence. My appointment was exactly what I needed." — **Laura K.**, Austin, TX

## Mobile App Promo
Title: Your health, in your pocket
Subtitle: Download the MedBook app to search for doctors, manage appointments, and get reminders — all on the go. Available on iOS and Android.
CTA: "Download on the App Store" | "Get it on Google Play"

Key app features:
- Book and manage appointments anywhere
- Get real-time appointment reminders
- Access your visit history and provider details
- Read and leave verified reviews

## Header Navigation
- Logo: MedBook (links to home)
- Nav links: Browse · Help · Log In · Sign Up
- Mobile: Hamburger menu icon toggles a slide-out drawer with Browse, Log In, and Sign Up

## Footer Navigation
**For Patients:** Find a Doctor · Browse Specialties · Read Reviews · Insurance Guide
**For Providers:** List Your Practice · Provider Resources · Advertise with Us
**Company:** About MedBook · Careers · Press · Blog · Contact Us
**Legal:** Terms of Service · Privacy Policy · Accessibility · Do Not Sell My Info

Tagline in footer: © 2024 MedBook, Inc. All rights reserved. MedBook is free for patients. Always.

# Web Design Expert

Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.

## When to Use This Skill

**Use for:**
- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
- Color palette creation and rationale
- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
- Component visual design (not just code)
- Responsive design strategy
- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements

**Do NOT use for:**
- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**

## Core Design Process

### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)

```
BUSINESS CONTEXT:
- What is the primary goal?
- Who is the target audience?
- What action should users take?
- Who are competitors?

BRAND PERSONALITY:
- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
```

### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)

Each concept includes:
- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)

## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard

**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**

OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)

```css
/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
```

**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
| Resource | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |

**When presenting color palettes:**
```
Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
```

Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.

### 3. Design Principles

**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?

**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?

## Common Anti-Patterns

### Design by Committee
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |

### Decoration Over Function
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |

### Ignoring the Fold
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |

### Low Contrast Text
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |

### Mobile as Afterthought
| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
|--------------------|----------------|
| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |

## Design Trend Evolution

| Era | Trend |
|-----|-------|
| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |

**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
- Flat design without depth
- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
- Desktop hamburger menus

## Output Deliverables

1. **Brand Identity Guide**: Colors, typography, voice, do's/don'ts
2. **Design Specifications**: Spacing, radius, shadows, animation timing
3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)
4. **Responsive Guidelines**: Breakpoints, layout changes, touch targets

Paired skills are bundled at `paired-skills/` in this skill directory. Read the corresponding SKILL.md when you need deeper expertise:

| **vibe-matcher** | `vibe-matcher/SKILL.md` | Translating emotional vibes to visual DNA |

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>MedBook — Find and Book Top Doctors Instantly</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ===== DESIGN TOKENS (OKLCH) ===== */
:root {
  --blue-primary: oklch(52% 0.22 264);
  --blue-primary-hover: oklch(45% 0.24 264);
  --blue-light: oklch(95% 0.04 264);
  --blue-bg: oklch(97% 0.02 264);
  --teal-accent: oklch(62% 0.16 168);
  --teal-accent-hover: oklch(55% 0.18 168);
  --teal-light: oklch(94% 0.06 168);
  --white: oklch(100% 0 0);
  --gray-50: oklch(98% 0.005 264);
  --gray-100: oklch(96% 0.005 264);
  --gray-200: oklch(92% 0.008 264);
  --gray-300: oklch(85% 0.01 264);
  --gray-400: oklch(70% 0.015 264);
  --gray-500: oklch(55% 0.015 264);
  --gray-600: oklch(40% 0.02 264);
  --gray-700: oklch(30% 0.02 264);
  --gray-800: oklch(22% 0.02 264);
  --text-primary: oklch(18% 0.02 264);
  --text-secondary: oklch(45% 0.02 264);
  --text-muted: oklch(60% 0.015 264);
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.08);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.1);
  --shadow-lg: 0 8px 30px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.12);
  --shadow-xl: 0 16px 50px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.15);
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --radius-xl: 24px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;
}

/* ===== RESET & BASE ===== */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: var(--white);
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
ul { list-style: none; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
button { cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; border: none; background: none; }
input, select { font-family: inherit; }

/* ===== UTILITIES ===== */
.container {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}

.section-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  color: var(--teal-accent);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.section-title {
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.section-subtitle {
  font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 18px);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 560px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ===== HEADER ===== */
.header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.06);
  transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.header.scrolled {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.header-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 72px;
}

.logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--blue-primary);
}

.logo-icon {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  background: var(--blue-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.logo-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

.nav-desktop {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.nav-link {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.nav-link:hover {
  color: var(--blue-primary);
  background: var(--blue-light);
}

.nav-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.btn-login {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--blue-primary);
  padding: 8px 20px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-login:hover {
  background: var(--blue-light);
}

.btn-signup {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--white);
  background: var(--blue-primary);
  padding: 10px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-signup:hover {
  background: var(--blue-primary-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(52% 0.22 264 / 0.3);
}

.hamburger {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 8px;
  z-index: 1001;
}

.hamburger span {
  display: block;
  width: 24px;
  height: 2.5px;
  background: var(--gray-700);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
  transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
}
.hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
  opacity: 0;
}
.hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
  transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(6px, -6px);
}

/* Mobile drawer */
.mobile-drawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; right: 0;
  width: 300px;
  max-width: 85vw;
  height: 100vh;
  background: var(--white);
  z-index: 999;
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  padding: 96px 32px 32px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}

.mobile-drawer.open {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.mobile-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.4);
  z-index: 998;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.mobile-overlay.active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.mobile-drawer .nav-link {
  display: block;
  font-size: 18px;
  padding: 14px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
  border-radius: 0;
}

.mobile-drawer .nav-actions {
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-top: 24px;
  gap: 12px;
}

.mobile-drawer .btn-login,
.mobile-drawer .btn-signup {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 14px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

/* ===== HERO ===== */
.hero {
  padding: 140px 0 80px;
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--white) 0%, var(--blue-bg) 50%, oklch(94% 0.05 168) 100%);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -200px;
  right: -200px;
  width: 600px;
  height: 600px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(52% 0.22 264 / 0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.hero::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -100px;
  left: -100px;
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(62% 0.16 168 / 0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.hero-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto 48px;
}

.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--teal-light);
  color: oklch(35% 0.12 168);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.hero-badge svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

.hero-title {
  font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 56px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.hero-title .highlight {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-primary), var(--teal-accent));
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-size: clamp(17px, 2.2vw, 20px);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 580px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ===== SEARCH BAR ===== */
.search-container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  max-width: 880px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.search-bar {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
  padding: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 4px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.search-bar:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--blue-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl), 0 0 0 4px oklch(52% 0.22 264 / 0.1);
}

.search-field {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
}

.search-field:focus-within {
  background: var(--gray-50);
}

.search-field svg {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  color: var(--gray-400);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.search-field input,
.search-field select {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  width: 100%;
}

.search-field input::placeholder {
  color: var(--gray-400);

/* Autocomplete dropdown */
.autocomplete-dropdown {

.autocomplete-item {

.autocomplete-item-text {

/* ===== STATS BAR ===== */
.stats-bar {

.stat-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.stat-number {
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 36px);

  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1;

.stat-label {
  font-size: 14px;

/* ===== SPECIALTIES ===== */
.specialties {

}

.specialty-icon {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;

  color: var(--blue-primary);

  justify-content: center;

}

.specialty-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.specialty-name {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.specialty-desc {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.specialty-arrow {
  color: var(--gray-300);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  align-self: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.specialty-card:hover .specialty-arrow {
  color: var(--blue-primary);
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

.specialty-arrow svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

/* ===== HOW IT WORKS ===== */
.how-it-works {
  padding: 80px 0;

}

  text-align: center;

}

.steps-grid::before {
  content: '';

  top: 48px;
  left: calc(16.67% + 24px);

}

.step-card {
  text-align: center;

}

.step-number {
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
  border-radius: 50%;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 800;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.step-card:nth-child(1) .step-number {
  background: var(--blue-light);
  color: var(--blue-primary);
}

.step-card:nth-child(2) .step-number {
  background: oklch(95% 0.04 200);

}

.step-card:nth-child(3) .step-number {
  background: var(--teal-light);
  color: var(--teal-accent);
}

.step-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.step-desc {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 300px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
.testimonials {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--gray-50);
}

.testimonials-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.testimonials-header .section-subtitle {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.testimonials-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
}

.testimonial-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 32px;

  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;

}

.testimonial-card:hover {

}

.testimonial-stars {
  display: flex;

}

.testimonial-stars svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

.testimonial-text {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.7;
  flex: 1;
  font-style: italic;
}

.testimonial-author {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.testimonial-avatar {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
}

.testimonial-card:nth-child(1) .testimonial-avatar { background: oklch(60% 0.18 280); }
.testimonial-card:nth-child(2) .testimonial-avatar { background: oklch(60% 0.18 200); }
.testimonial-card:nth-child(3) .testimonial-avatar { background: var(--teal-accent); }

.testimonial-name {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.testimonial-location {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.app-promo {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

.app-promo-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
}

.app-promo-content {
  max-width: 480px;
}

.app-promo .section-title {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.app-promo .section-subtitle {
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  max-width: 440px;
}

.app-features {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
}

.app-feature {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.app-feature-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--teal-light);
  color: var(--teal-accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.app-feature-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.app-buttons {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.app-store-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--text-primary);
  color: var(--white);
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.app-store-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.app-store-btn svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.app-store-btn-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.app-store-btn-text small {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.app-store-btn-text strong {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Phone mockup */
.app-promo-visual {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
}

.phone-mockup {
  width: 280px;
  height: 560px;
  background: var(--gray-800);
  border-radius: 40px;
  padding: 12px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}

.phone-mockup::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 80px;
  height: 24px;
  background: var(--gray-700);
  border-radius: 12px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.phone-screen {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--blue-primary), oklch(55% 0.18 200), var(--teal-accent));
  border-radius: 30px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 60px 24px 40px;
  color: var(--white);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.phone-screen-icon {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.phone-screen-icon svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; }

.phone-screen-title {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
}

.phone-screen-subtitle {
  font-size: 14px;
  opacity: 0.85;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.phone-mockup-cards {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.phone-mockup-card {
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Floating decorations */
.app-promo-visual .float-dot {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(1) {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  background: var(--teal-accent);
  top: 15%; left: 10%;
  animation-delay: 0s;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(2) {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  background: var(--blue-primary);
  top: 60%; right: 5%;
  animation-delay: 2s;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(3) {
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  background: oklch(78% 0.16 85);
  bottom: 20%; left: 5%;
  animation-delay: 4s;
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
}

.footer {

.footer-logo-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

.footer-brand p {

.footer-heading {

<script>
// ===== HEADER SCROLL EFFECT =====
const header = document.getElementById('header');
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
});

// ===== MOBILE MENU =====
const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

function openMobileMenu() {
  hamburger.classList.add('active');
  mobileDrawer.classList.add('open');
  mobileOverlay.classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeMobileMenu() {
  hamburger.classList.remove('active');
  mobileDrawer.classList.remove('open');
  mobileOverlay.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (mobileDrawer.classList.contains('open')) {
    closeMobileMenu();
  } else {
    openMobileMenu();
  }
});

mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

// ===== AUTOCOMPLETE =====
const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
const autocompleteDropdown = document.getElementById('autocompleteDropdown');

const suggestions = [
  { text: 'Dentist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Dermatologist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Primary Care Doctor', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Psychiatrist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Eye Doctor', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Orthopedic Surgeon', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Back Pain', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Acne', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Anxiety', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Headache', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Allergies', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Dr. Sarah Chen', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. Michael Park', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. Jessica Lee', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. David Kim', category: 'Doctor' },
];

let selectedIdx = -1;

searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  const val = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  selectedIdx = -1;

  if (val.length < 1) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  const matches = suggestions.filter(s =>
    s.text.toLowerCase().includes(val)
  ).slice(0, 6);

  if (matches.length === 0) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  autocompleteDropdown.innerHTML = matches.map((m, i) => `
    <div class="autocomplete-item" data-index="${i}">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/>
      </svg>
      <span class="autocomplete-item-text">${highlightMatch(m.text, val)}</span>
      <span class="autocomplete-item-category">${m.category}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  autocompleteDropdown.classList.add('active');

  autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      searchInput.value = item.querySelector('.autocomplete-item-text').textContent;
      autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    });
  });
});

function highlightMatch(text, query) {
  const idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query);
  if (idx === -1) return text;
  return text.slice(0, idx) + '<strong>' + text.slice(idx, idx + query.length) + '</strong>' + text.slice(idx + query.length);
}

searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const items = autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item');
  if (!items.length) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectedIdx = Math.min(selectedIdx + 1, items.length - 1);
    updateSelected(items);
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectedIdx = Math.max(selectedIdx - 1, 0);
    updateSelected(items);
  } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchInput.value = items[selectedIdx].querySelector('.autocomplete-item-text').textContent;
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

function updateSelected(items) {
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    item.classList.toggle('selected', i === selectedIdx);
  });
}

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.search-container')) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

// ===== SEARCH FORM =====
document.getElementById('searchForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const q = searchInput.value;
  const loc = document.getElementById('locationInput').value;
  const ins = document.getElementById('insuranceSelect').value;
  // In production this would navigate to search results
  console.log('Search submitted:', { query: q, location: loc, insurance: ins });
});

// ===== SPECIALTY CARDS =====
document.querySelectorAll('.specialty-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;
    // In production this would navigate to filtered search results
    console.log('Specialty selected:', specialty);
  });
});

// ===== SCROLL ANIMATIONS =====
const fadeElements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('visible');
      observer.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

fadeElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>

.app-store-btn-text strong {

/* Phone mockup */
.app-promo-visual {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
}

.phone-mockup {
  width: 280px;
  height: 560px;
  background: var(--gray-800);
  border-radius: 40px;
  padding: 12px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}

.phone-mockup::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 80px;
  height: 24px;
  background: var(--gray-700);
  border-radius: 12px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.phone-screen {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--blue-primary), oklch(55% 0.18 200), var(--teal-accent));
  border-radius: 30px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 60px 24px 40px;
  color: var(--white);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.phone-screen-icon {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.phone-screen-icon svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; }

.phone-screen-title {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
}

.phone-screen-subtitle {
  font-size: 14px;
  opacity: 0.85;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.phone-mockup-cards {
  width: 100%;

  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.phone-mockup-card {
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Floating decorations */
.app-promo-visual .float-dot {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(1) {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  background: var(--teal-accent);
  top: 15%; left: 10%;
  animation-delay: 0s;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(2) {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  background: var(--blue-primary);
  top: 60%; right: 5%;
  animation-delay: 2s;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(3) {
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  background: oklch(78% 0.16 85);
  bottom: 20%; left: 5%;
  animation-delay: 4s;
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
}

<script>
// ===== HEADER SCROLL EFFECT =====
const header = document.getElementById('header');
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
});

// ===== MOBILE MENU =====
const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

function openMobileMenu() {
  hamburger.classList.add('active');
  mobileDrawer.classList.add('open');
  mobileOverlay.classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeMobileMenu() {
  hamburger.classList.remove('active');
  mobileDrawer.classList.remove('open');
  mobileOverlay.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (mobileDrawer.classList.contains('open')) {
    closeMobileMenu();
  } else {
    openMobileMenu();
  }
});

mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

// ===== AUTOCOMPLETE =====
const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
const autocompleteDropdown = document.getElementById('autocompleteDropdown');

const suggestions = [
  { text: 'Dentist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Dermatologist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Primary Care Doctor', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Psychiatrist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Eye Doctor', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Orthopedic Surgeon', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Back Pain', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Acne', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Anxiety', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Headache', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Allergies', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Dr. Sarah Chen', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. Michael Park', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. Jessica Lee', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. David Kim', category: 'Doctor' },
];

let selectedIdx = -1;

searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  const val = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  selectedIdx = -1;

  if (val.length < 1) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  const matches = suggestions.filter(s =>
    s.text.toLowerCase().includes(val)
  ).slice(0, 6);

  if (matches.length === 0) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  autocompleteDropdown.innerHTML = matches.map((m, i) => `
    <div class="autocomplete-item" data-index="${i}">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/>
      </svg>
      <span class="autocomplete-item-text">${highlightMatch(m.text, val)}</span>
      <span class="autocomplete-item-category">${m.category}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  autocompleteDropdown.classList.add('active');

  autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      searchInput.value = item.querySelector('.autocomplete-item-text').textContent;
      autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    });
  });
});

function highlightMatch(text, query) {
  const idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query);
  if (idx === -1) return text;
  return text.slice(0, idx) + '<strong>' + text.slice(idx, idx + query.length) + '</strong>' + text.slice(idx + query.length);
}

searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const items = autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item');
  if (!items.length) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectedIdx = Math.min(selectedIdx + 1, items.length - 1);
    updateSelected(items);
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectedIdx = Math.max(selectedIdx - 1, 0);
    updateSelected(items);
  } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchInput.value = items[selectedIdx].querySelector('.autocomplete-item-text').textContent;
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

function updateSelected(items) {
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    item.classList.toggle('selected', i === selectedIdx);
  });
}

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.search-container')) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

// ===== SEARCH FORM =====
document.getElementById('searchForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const q = searchInput.value;
  const loc = document.getElementById('locationInput').value;
  const ins = document.getElementById('insuranceSelect').value;
  // In production this would navigate to search results
  console.log('Search submitted:', { query: q, location: loc, insurance: ins });
});

// ===== SPECIALTY CARDS =====
document.querySelectorAll('.specialty-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;
    // In production this would navigate to filtered search results
    console.log('Specialty selected:', specialty);
  });
});

// ===== SCROLL ANIMATIONS =====
const fadeElements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('visible');
      observer.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

fadeElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>

  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--blue-primary);
  padding: 8px 20px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-login:hover {
  background: var(--blue-light);
}

.btn-signup {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--white);
  background: var(--blue-primary);
  padding: 10px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-signup:hover {
  background: var(--blue-primary-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(52% 0.22 264 / 0.3);
}

.hamburger {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 8px;
  z-index: 1001;
}

.hamburger span {
  display: block;
  width: 24px;
  height: 2.5px;
  background: var(--gray-700);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
  transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
}
.hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
  opacity: 0;
}
.hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
  transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(6px, -6px);
}

/* Mobile drawer */
.mobile-drawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; right: 0;
  width: 300px;
  max-width: 85vw;
  height: 100vh;
  background: var(--white);
  z-index: 999;
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  padding: 96px 32px 32px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}

.mobile-drawer.open {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.mobile-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.4);
  z-index: 998;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.mobile-overlay.active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.mobile-drawer .nav-link {
  display: block;
  font-size: 18px;
  padding: 14px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
  border-radius: 0;
}

.mobile-drawer .nav-actions {
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-top: 24px;
  gap: 12px;
}

.mobile-drawer .btn-login,
.mobile-drawer .btn-signup {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 14px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

/* ===== HERO ===== */
.hero {
  padding: 140px 0 80px;
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--white) 0%, var(--blue-bg) 50%, oklch(94% 0.05 168) 100%);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -200px;
  right: -200px;
  width: 600px;
  height: 600px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(52% 0.22 264 / 0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.hero::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -100px;
  left: -100px;
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(62% 0.16 168 / 0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.hero-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto 48px;
}

.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--teal-light);
  color: oklch(35% 0.12 168);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.hero-badge svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

.hero-title {
  font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 56px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.hero-title .highlight {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-primary), var(--teal-accent));
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-size: clamp(17px, 2.2vw, 20px);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 580px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ===== SEARCH BAR ===== */
.search-container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  max-width: 880px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.search-bar {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
  padding: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 4px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.search-bar:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--blue-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl), 0 0 0 4px oklch(52% 0.22 264 / 0.1);
}

.search-field {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
}

.search-field:focus-within {
  background: var(--gray-50);
}

.search-field svg {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  color: var(--gray-400);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.search-field input,
.search-field select {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  width: 100%;
}

.search-field input::placeholder {
  color: var(--gray-400);
}

.search-field select {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.search-divider {
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--gray-200);
  align-self: stretch;
  margin: 8px 0;
}

.btn-search {
  background: var(--teal-accent);
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 14px 32px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.btn-search:hover {
  background: var(--teal-accent-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(62% 0.16 168 / 0.35);
}

.btn-search svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
}

/* Autocomplete dropdown */
.autocomplete-dropdown {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: none;
  z-index: 100;
}

.autocomplete-dropdown.active {
  display: block;
  animation: dropIn 0.2s ease;
}

@keyframes dropIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.autocomplete-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.autocomplete-item:hover,
.autocomplete-item.selected {
  background: var(--blue-light);
}

.autocomplete-item svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  color: var(--gray-400);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.autocomplete-item-text {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.autocomplete-item-category {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-left: auto;
}

/* ===== STATS BAR ===== */
.stats-bar {
  padding: 48px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

.stats-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 32px;
  text-align: center;
}

.stat-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.stat-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.stat-icon.blue { background: var(--blue-light); color: var(--blue-primary); }
.stat-icon.teal { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal-accent); }

.stat-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.stat-number {
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1;
}

.stat-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-weight: 500;
  max-width: 180px;
}

/* ===== SPECIALTIES ===== */
.specialties {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--gray-50);
}

.specialties-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.specialties-header .section-subtitle {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.specialties-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.specialty-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px 24px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 16px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.specialty-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  border-color: var(--blue-primary);
}

.specialty-card:hover .specialty-icon {
  background: var(--blue-primary);
  color: var(--white);
}

.specialty-icon {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--blue-light);
  color: var(--blue-primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.specialty-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.specialty-info { flex: 1; }

.specialty-name {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.specialty-desc {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.specialty-arrow {
  color: var(--gray-300);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  align-self: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.specialty-card:hover .specialty-arrow {
  color: var(--blue-primary);
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

.specialty-arrow svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

/* ===== HOW IT WORKS ===== */
.how-it-works {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

.how-it-works-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 56px;
}

.how-it-works-header .section-subtitle {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.steps-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 40px;
  position: relative;
}

.steps-grid::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 48px;
  left: calc(16.67% + 24px);
  right: calc(16.67% + 24px);
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue-primary), var(--teal-accent));
  border-radius: 1px;
}

.step-card {
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}

.step-number {
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 800;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.step-card:nth-child(1) .step-number {
  background: var(--blue-light);
  color: var(--blue-primary);
}

.step-card:nth-child(2) .step-number {
  background: oklch(95% 0.04 200);
  color: oklch(50% 0.2 200);
}

.step-card:nth-child(3) .step-number {
  background: var(--teal-light);
  color: var(--teal-accent);
}

.step-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.step-desc {
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 300px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
.testimonials {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--gray-50);
}

.testimonials-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.testimonials-header .section-subtitle {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.testimonials-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
}

.testimonial-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 32px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.testimonial-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.testimonial-stars {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2px;
  color: oklch(78% 0.16 85);
}

.testimonial-stars svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

.testimonial-text {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.7;
  flex: 1;
  font-style: italic;
}

.testimonial-author {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.testimonial-avatar {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--white);
}

.testimonial-card:nth-child(1) .testimonial-avatar { background: oklch(60% 0.18 280); }
.testimonial-card:nth-child(2) .testimonial-avatar { background: oklch(60% 0.18 200); }
.testimonial-card:nth-child(3) .testimonial-avatar { background: var(--teal-accent); }

.testimonial-name {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.testimonial-location {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* ===== MOBILE APP PROMO ===== */
.app-promo {
  padding: 80px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

.app-promo-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
}

.app-promo-content {
  max-width: 480px;
}

.app-promo .section-title {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.app-promo .section-subtitle {
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  max-width: 440px;
}

.app-features {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
}

.app-feature {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.app-feature-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--teal-light);
  color: var(--teal-accent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.app-feature-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.app-buttons {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.app-store-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  background: var(--text-primary);
  color: var(--white);
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.app-store-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.app-store-btn svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.app-store-btn-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.app-store-btn-text small {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.app-store-btn-text strong {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Phone mockup */
.app-promo-visual {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
}

.phone-mockup {
  width: 280px;
  height: 560px;
  background: var(--gray-800);
  border-radius: 40px;
  padding: 12px;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}

.phone-mockup::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 80px;
  height: 24px;
  background: var(--gray-700);
  border-radius: 12px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.phone-screen {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--blue-primary), oklch(55% 0.18 200), var(--teal-accent));
  border-radius: 30px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 60px 24px 40px;
  color: var(--white);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.phone-screen-icon {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.phone-screen-icon svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; }

.phone-screen-title {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
}

.phone-screen-subtitle {
  font-size: 14px;
  opacity: 0.85;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.phone-mockup-cards {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.phone-mockup-card {
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* Floating decorations */
.app-promo-visual .float-dot {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(1) {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  background: var(--teal-accent);
  top: 15%; left: 10%;
  animation-delay: 0s;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(2) {
  width: 8px; height: 8px;
  background: var(--blue-primary);
  top: 60%; right: 5%;
  animation-delay: 2s;
}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(3) {
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  background: oklch(78% 0.16 85);
  bottom: 20%; left: 5%;
  animation-delay: 4s;
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
}

/* ===== FOOTER ===== */
.footer {
  padding: 64px 0 32px;
  background: oklch(14% 0.02 264);
  color: oklch(80% 0.01 264);
}

.footer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.footer-brand {
  max-width: 280px;
}

.footer-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--white);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.footer-logo-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  background: var(--blue-primary);
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.footer-logo-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

.footer-brand p {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: oklch(65% 0.01 264);
}

.footer-heading {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--white);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.footer-links {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.footer-link {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: oklch(65% 0.01 264);
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.footer-link:hover {
  color: var(--white);
}

.footer-bottom {
  border-top: 1px solid oklch(25% 0.02 264);
  padding-top: 24px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: oklch(55% 0.01 264);
}

.footer-bottom-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
}

.footer-bottom-links a {
  color: oklch(55% 0.01 264);
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.footer-bottom-links a:hover {
  color: oklch(80% 0.01 264);
}

/* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .specialties-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .app-promo-inner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 48px;
  }

  .app-promo-content {
    max-width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .app-promo .section-subtitle {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
  }

  .app-features {
    align-items: center;
  }

  .app-buttons {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .footer-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .footer-brand {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .nav-desktop, .nav-actions { display: none; }
  .hamburger { display: flex; }

  .hero {
    padding: 120px 0 60px;
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(30px, 7vw, 42px);
  }

  .search-bar {
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 12px;

// ===== HEADER SCROLL EFFECT =====
const header = document.getElementById('header');

});

// ===== MOBILE MENU =====
const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

function openMobileMenu() {
  hamburger.classList.add('active');
  mobileDrawer.classList.add('open');
  mobileOverlay.classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeMobileMenu() {
  hamburger.classList.remove('active');
  mobileDrawer.classList.remove('open');
  mobileOverlay.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (mobileDrawer.classList.contains('open')) {
    closeMobileMenu();
  } else {
    openMobileMenu();
  }
});

mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

// ===== AUTOCOMPLETE =====
const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
const autocompleteDropdown = document.getElementById('autocompleteDropdown');

const suggestions = [
  { text: 'Dentist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Dermatologist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Primary Care Doctor', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Psychiatrist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Eye Doctor', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Orthopedic Surgeon', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Back Pain', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Acne', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Anxiety', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Headache', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Allergies', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Dr. Sarah Chen', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. Michael Park', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. Jessica Lee', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. David Kim', category: 'Doctor' },
];

let selectedIdx = -1;

searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  const val = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  selectedIdx = -1;

  if (val.length < 1) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  const matches = suggestions.filter(s =>
    s.text.toLowerCase().includes(val)
  ).slice(0, 6);

  if (matches.length === 0) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  autocompleteDropdown.innerHTML = matches.map((m, i) => `
    <div class="autocomplete-item" data-index="${i}">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/>
      </svg>
      <span class="autocomplete-item-text">${highlightMatch(m.text, val)}</span>
      <span class="autocomplete-item-category">${m.category}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  autocompleteDropdown.classList.add('active');

  autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      searchInput.value = item.querySelector('.autocomplete-item-text').textContent;
      autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    });
  });
});

function highlightMatch(text, query) {
  const idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query);
  if (idx === -1) return text;
  return text.slice(0, idx) + '<strong>' + text.slice(idx, idx + query.length) + '</strong>' + text.slice(idx + query.length);
}

searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const items = autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item');
  if (!items.length) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectedIdx = Math.min(selectedIdx + 1, items.length - 1);
    updateSelected(items);
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectedIdx = Math.max(selectedIdx - 1, 0);
    updateSelected(items);
  } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchInput.value = items[selectedIdx].querySelector('.autocomplete-item-text').textContent;
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

function updateSelected(items) {
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    item.classList.toggle('selected', i === selectedIdx);
  });
}

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.search-container')) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

// ===== SEARCH FORM =====
document.getElementById('searchForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const q = searchInput.value;
  const loc = document.getElementById('locationInput').value;
  const ins = document.getElementById('insuranceSelect').value;
  // In production this would navigate to search results
  console.log('Search submitted:', { query: q, location: loc, insurance: ins });
});

// ===== SPECIALTY CARDS =====
document.querySelectorAll('.specialty-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;
    // In production this would navigate to filtered search results
    console.log('Specialty selected:', specialty);
  });
});

// ===== SCROLL ANIMATIONS =====
const fadeElements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('visible');
      observer.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

fadeElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>

</html>

/* ===== HOW IT WORKS ===== */

.step-desc {

/* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
.testimonials {

}

  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 48px;

.testimonials-header .section-subtitle {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.testimonials-grid {

.testimonial-card {

.testimonial-text {

.testimonial-avatar {

.app-promo-content {

.app-promo .section-title {

.app-promo .section-subtitle {

.app-feature-icon {

}

.app-feature-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.app-buttons {

}

.app-store-btn {

  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;

}

.app-store-btn:hover {

}

.app-store-btn svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }

.app-store-btn-text {

}

.app-store-btn-text small {

.app-store-btn-text strong {

}

}

.phone-mockup::before {
  content: '';

  height: 24px;
  background: var(--gray-700);
  border-radius: 12px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.phone-screen {
  width: 100%;

  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;

.phone-mockup-cards {

}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(1) {

}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(2) {

}

.app-promo-visual .float-dot:nth-child(3) {
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  background: oklch(78% 0.16 85);

  animation-delay: 4s;
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-12px); }
}

<script>
// ===== HEADER SCROLL EFFECT =====
const header = document.getElementById('header');
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
});

// ===== MOBILE MENU =====
const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

function openMobileMenu() {
  hamburger.classList.add('active');
  mobileDrawer.classList.add('open');
  mobileOverlay.classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}

function closeMobileMenu() {
  hamburger.classList.remove('active');
  mobileDrawer.classList.remove('open');
  mobileOverlay.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (mobileDrawer.classList.contains('open')) {
    closeMobileMenu();
  } else {
    openMobileMenu();
  }
});

mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

// ===== AUTOCOMPLETE =====
const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
const autocompleteDropdown = document.getElementById('autocompleteDropdown');

const suggestions = [
  { text: 'Dentist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Dermatologist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Primary Care Doctor', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Psychiatrist', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Eye Doctor', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Orthopedic Surgeon', category: 'Specialty' },
  { text: 'Back Pain', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Acne', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Anxiety', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Headache', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Allergies', category: 'Condition' },
  { text: 'Dr. Sarah Chen', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. Michael Park', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. Jessica Lee', category: 'Doctor' },
  { text: 'Dr. David Kim', category: 'Doctor' },
];

let selectedIdx = -1;

searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
  const val = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  selectedIdx = -1;

  if (val.length < 1) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  const matches = suggestions.filter(s =>
    s.text.toLowerCase().includes(val)
  ).slice(0, 6);

  if (matches.length === 0) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    return;
  }

  autocompleteDropdown.innerHTML = matches.map((m, i) => `
    <div class="autocomplete-item" data-index="${i}">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/>
      </svg>
      <span class="autocomplete-item-text">${highlightMatch(m.text, val)}</span>
      <span class="autocomplete-item-category">${m.category}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  autocompleteDropdown.classList.add('active');

  autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      searchInput.value = item.querySelector('.autocomplete-item-text').textContent;
      autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
    });
  });
});

function highlightMatch(text, query) {
  const idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query);
  if (idx === -1) return text;
  return text.slice(0, idx) + '<strong>' + text.slice(idx, idx + query.length) + '</strong>' + text.slice(idx + query.length);
}

searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const items = autocompleteDropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item');
  if (!items.length) return;

  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectedIdx = Math.min(selectedIdx + 1, items.length - 1);
    updateSelected(items);
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectedIdx = Math.max(selectedIdx - 1, 0);
    updateSelected(items);
  } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    e.preventDefault();
    searchInput.value = items[selectedIdx].querySelector('.autocomplete-item-text').textContent;
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

function updateSelected(items) {
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    item.classList.toggle('selected', i === selectedIdx);
  });
}

document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.search-container')) {
    autocompleteDropdown.classList.remove('active');
  }
});

// ===== SEARCH FORM =====
document.getElementById('searchForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const q = searchInput.value;
  const loc = document.getElementById('locationInput').value;
  const ins = document.getElementById('insuranceSelect').value;
  // In production this would navigate to search results
  console.log('Search submitted:', { query: q, location: loc, insurance: ins });
});

// ===== SPECIALTY CARDS =====
document.querySelectorAll('.specialty-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;
    // In production this would navigate to filtered search results
    console.log('Specialty selected:', specialty);
  });
});

// ===== SCROLL ANIMATIONS =====
const fadeElements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      entry.target.classList.add('visible');
      observer.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

fadeElements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>

</body>
</html>
